changelog:
- Initial release of the daily-briefing skill, providing structured morning briefings for agents.
- Delivers concise daily summaries covering calendar, tasks, weather, news, and top priorities.
- Supports scheduled (cron), heartbeat, and on-demand triggers across multiple platforms.
- Highly customizable via BRIEFING.md, including sections, tone, and weekend mode.
- Designed for easy, no-code setup with clear troubleshooting and advanced configuration options.
summary: Structured morning briefing skill — daily summaries covering calendar, tasks, weather, news, and priorities. Supports cron, heartbeat, and on-demand triggers.
